Owner UID:

Paint pixels or import a PNG. Skins use 64×64, capes/elytra use 64×32, and animated Ears wings use 20×16.

Host with Playit across different networks. Your vanilla server accepts offline usernames; Playit forwards its public address to this device.

Playit · free Minecraft Java tunnel

Start a server, then choose Share with Playit.

Link the agent with your free Playit account. Only the host runs the agent; friends connect directly to its public address. Anyone with the address can connect while you host.

Your friends & servers

Vanilla dedicated servers use a separate world, 8 player slots and conservative chunk distances. Modded server packs need their own compatible server setup. Keep this launcher open while hosting.
